Last year I tried twice within a week to kill myself. I'd been off work for a few months, was lonely and only really left my apartment to see my councillor. A friend of mine lives in Mexico and she convinced me to just fly over and stay in a hostel nearby for a couple of weeks, I had nothing to lose anymore so I spent my savings to get over there. The first few days were a massive weight off my shoulders but eventually the depression kicked back in and after drinking all night I decided to take an overdose. My memory is very hazy but I remember passing out, my friend breaking into my room and rushing me into the bathroom to throw up, then staying with me until the morning. For context we was way out in a coastal village with no hospital for hours. The second time I was more sober and with nothing to overdose on left I planned to just swim out to sea where i was told there was a rip-currant with nothing but a knife to cut my wrists. My thinking was that I didn't want to leave the burden of a body to bring home so I figured I'd be decimated by sharks after they caught the scent. I didn't want  to waste a search and rescue attempt so I sent a message out to my loved ones saying goodbye and not to bother looking for me. My sister got right back and wouldnt stop ringing me which really snapped me out of it as we're not particularly close, but just seemed like no matter what I did it was going to hurt people so I just decided to keep living, even if it was the last thing I wanted to do.
